notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
